title: The Delta Set of a Numerical Monoid Generated by a Generalized Arithmetic Sequence
summary: Let \[ S_h=\langle a,ah+d,ah+2d,\ldots,ah+kd\rangle, \qquad \gcd(a,d)=1,\quad 1 1, \] be a numerical monoid generated by a generalized arithmetic sequence. In this paper, we determine the delta set \[Δ(S_h),\] resolving an open problem posed by Christopher O'Neill and Roberto Pelayo in 2014 \cite{ONeill}. Writing $e=h-1$ and letting $E(e,d)$ denote the set of values arising from the subtractive Euclidean algorithm applied to $e$ and $d$, we prove that \[ Δ(S_h) = E(h-1,d)\cup \{M-r(h-1):M-r(h-1)>0,\ r\geq0\}, \] where \[ M=\left\lceil\frac{a}{k}\right\rceil(h-1)+d \] is the maximal element…
